- Detailed logging for development/debugging
- Maintains backward compatibility with email outbox
- Supports both test domain (onboarding@resend.dev) and custom domains

Testing:
- All unit tests passing (124/124)
- Email successfully sent and delivered to Gmail
- Comprehensive error handling and logging
- Environment variable loading verified

partialFingerprints.commitMessage:
# feat(auth): standardize Bearer token authentication for e2e tests

## Problem
E2e tests were using inconsistent authentication methods with a mix of session cookies and Bearer tokens,
causing unpredictable test results and failures in the CI/CD pipeline.

## Solution
- Updated test setup to use Bearer tokens consistently across all tests
- Fixed authentication service implementation for tests with proper mocks
- Added missing @testing-library/dom dependency for web tests
- Modified test fixtures to expose tokens to test cases
- Implemented route interception to add auth headers to requests

## Additional Changes
- Fixed API authentication middleware to properly handle Bearer tokens
- Updated test documentation to explain authentication approach
- Verified API endpoints work correctly with Bearer auth
- Enhanced test framework for consistent token handling
- Removed temporary testing files (login-analysis.ts, login-page.html)
- Updated authentication-system.md to document Bearer token usage

## Testing
- Ran full e2e test suite to verify Bearer token authentication works
- Verified login, API calls, and protected routes function correctly

## Testing
- All integration tests now pass consistently
- Verified proper cleanup of test database files
- Ensured tests are properly isolated from each other

This addresses the long-standing issue of flaky integration tests and provides a clear
pattern for future database integration testing.

# fix(api): improve database integration test isolation

## Problem
Integration tests were failing due to poor database isolation between test runs, with
tests using the real database instead of isolated test databases. This caused tests to
interfere with each other and produced inconsistent results.

## Solution
- Modified `connectDatabase()` to dynamically read DB_PATH for each connection
- Added new `closeDatabase()` function for proper cleanup between tests
- Updated database connection management in integration tests
- Used unique file paths for test databases to ensure test isolation
- Added comprehensive documentation for database integration testing patterns

## Additional Changes
- Updated architectural documentation to reflect new best practices
- Enhanced testing checklist to mark completed tasks
- Added detailed examples of proper test setup/teardown patterns

## Testing
- All integration tests now pass consistently
- Verified proper cleanup of test database files
- Ensured tests are properly isolated from each other

This addresses the long-standing issue of flaky integration tests and provides a clear
pattern for future database integration testing.

- Added file validation checks for PDF and DOCX files using magic bytes/MIME type.
- Updated API documentation to reflect new validation rules and error responses.
- Implemented Markdown serialization for ResumeData to support fallback rendering.
- Created a new ResumeBuilderPage component for user input and resume preview.
- Improved logging for database connections and API server status.
- Added tests for file validation to ensure robustness against various file types and sizes.
- Removed redundant API endpoint for resume parsing, consolidating to a single endpoint.
- Updated package dependencies and scripts for cleaner build and development processes.
